reviews.comment: She is really an amazing professor. I've taken Dr. Carly-Miles twice and I'd do it again if I could. She runs on a grading contract system, so as long as you do the work (all the work) you get an A. She is not out to fail you, she just wants to talk about her books, so please read! She's one of the best profs on campus!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Carly-Miles is a great professor! She cares so much and truly wants to know your thoughts on the assigned reading. There is a good amount of reading, but it is an english class so that is to be expected. She truly values your learning over just a grade and is great at working with you. Wish I could take her again!

I took her for 203 and 322. Reading is heavy sometimes, especially in 322, but Carly-Miles is very communicative and adjusted assignments as we went. Very very caring - she truly wants to help and is very understanding. Uses a grading contract, so as long as you complete discussion posts and assignments, you'll get an A! My favorite English prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had her for the summer term. Class is manageable as long as you stay on top of your work, especially during the group project. There's a lot of writing, so don't push everything to the last minute just because this isn't a difficult class. She's very sweet.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was so nice!!! Easy to understand grading contract, so just do the work and do it well, and you will get an A. Take her if you can!

Dr. Carly-Miles is an incredibly kind and understanding professor. If you show up to class and do the readings (which aren't overly intensive), you will do well in the course. I absolutely recommend taking a course with her if you need a core English credit.

Very nice prof. She meets with students over zoom which is nice if you have any questions about the assignments. Some assignments can be a bit tedious and require you to look at the rubric and instructions very carefully. This class shouldn't be too difficult if you stay on top of your assignments!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Miles might be the nicest person on the planet! She really cares about her students and will make everyone feel special. She truly is a joy and made English enjoyable. Best professor at tAMU

Best prof I've had at TAMU! This course is very much like a high school class. Very small daily assignments, and the grading contract is awesome! You do speak in front of the class a bit, but you can make alternative arrangements with her if you're not comfortable with that. Very welcoming environment and she is just so sweet! Take her!!

I thought this class was a great way to knock an english credit out. You do have to write a bit but its writing resumes and proposals rather than essays which I personally loved. She is super nice and a good communicator for an online class but she definitely grades tough. We have group work and discussion due as well. The textbook was free.

This course has an excessive amount of work. Every week I had about 6 assignments due and most of them are busy work. The grade is based mainly on group work and group discussion boards online. You are randomly assigned these group yet expected to easily communicate with them. Only take this class if you are prepared for the work load.

Great professor! Class itself felt like high school English, having various types of reading/writing and analyses. Nothing is too difficult in the course, and discussions are enjoyable. She's very kind and fun to be around. Worst was pride and prejudice, but that was still bearable because of the fun assignments. Take her, she is great!

Dr. Carly-Miles has to be my favorite professor. She gives great feedback during office hours, so make sure you attend them. She is very caring and helpful. The major assignments are time-consuming, but not hard. Do not procrastinate on assignments. She is probably the best professor for ENGL-210.

For an online course, this class was more work than I was anticipating. Multiple weekly assignments. 3 Discussion posts, replies, assignments, etc. ~ 1000 words per week, sometimes more. Tough but fair grader. Biggest complaint is she does not grade in a timely fashion. Some assignments took 3 months to be returned causing repeated mistakes.
Class is a lot of work in the beginning if you get a group at the end it's not too bad. Sometimes she will actually grade your work other times she just gives everyone a 100.
Great professor for an annoying class. Started rough but got easier at the end.

The assignments are not difficult but do take time. Taught me a lot about the way I write. The textbook is necessary since the papers are formatted from the examples given in the book. Overall, she is very sweet and will help you look over how to improve your writing.

Be ready for a lot of writing. The final paper was around 12 pages long so don't wait till the last minute to think about it you can easily work on half of it by doing the other assignments. She is very accessible outside of class and always offered help. She was also accommodating and understanding with COVID.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took Prof. Carly-Miles for Hullabaloo U and really enjoyed the class. There were only about 10 or less of us and I really enjoyed the feel of a small class. This class helped me kind of talk about the transition to college and get more comfortable with being in college. She is an amazing professor!

The class is set up to split up your major assignments into smaller ones spread out so that you can't procrastinate the big stuff. Dr. CCM is very generous with her grading; she has a rubric but she gives more points than the rubric would suggest. From my experience, she was strict with small assignment deadlines but didn't penalize the big ones.

I took this class online and its the only way I would recommend taking it. There are weekly assignments but they are mainly participation, and there is one major project due each month. I loved this professor because she adjusted deadlines to make sure we had enough time to make them well done. It does take her a long time to grade, so be aware.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's very nice and if you go to office hours she will give you pointers on how to improve your writing. However, she takes FOREVER to grade assignments... you don't know your grade till the day grades are due. There are weekly assignments from the book that you have to do, but they are easy and take about 30 minutes.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Carly-Miles is one of the best proffesors I've had at A&M. She is incredibly loving and very helpful. for writings, she lets you pick topics that you like to express yourself and she will give feedback and tips for writing. I must admit, the grading can be long and knowing if you're doing good can be up in the air. But she was amazing overall.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Carly- Miles is the best English professor at A&M! She gives very good feedback and if you talk to her and tell her you need more time on an essay, she will extend the deadline without hesitation. She takes a while to grade the papers, but there is only 2 essays, a research paper and an Annotated Bibliography. TAKE HER CLASS! 100% recommend!!!!

She is an amazing professor! She is super sweet and really cares for her students. She is not a tough grader at all, we only have 3 essays and her classes are more like discussions. Every week we turned in discussion questions and we talked about them. She loves to hear different opinions and I would love to take her again if possible.

She's very helpful always available. She's very reasonable in her grading and assignments if she doesn't feel like it's necessary she wont make you do it. She grades fairly easily like 90%+ made an A in my section. She's really nice and a real mom. Don't really need the books as long as you can google the articles and stuff.

It takes a while to get back your grades, but she grades very fairly on the assignments. She is a good pick for this class and if you follow instructions and put some effort into your work you should come out with an "A". Great choice for an English credit and online class. (fall 2016 review)
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I'm currently in this class and I have no idea how I'm doing. She told us that papers we turned in 7 weeks ago would be graded in 1, 2 weeks max. Still waiting. Also she doesn't even put in the participation grades for our daily reading questions. I literally have no idea if I'm doing well in there or not.
